title: Attainment of perturbed-inverse c-differential bounds
summary: Determine whether both source bounds, eight and nine, are exact for the perturbed inverse function under their respective trace conditions.

formal_statement.body: Let $H(x)=x^{-1}+\operatorname{Tr}(x^2/(x+1))$ on $\mathbb F_{2^n}$ and let $c\in\mathbb F_{2^n}\setminus\{0,1\}$. Determine whether the source bounds are attainable in both branches: $${}_c\Delta_H\le 8\quad\text{if }\operatorname{Tr}(c)=\operatorname{Tr}(1/c)=1,$$ and $${}_c\Delta_H\le 9$$ otherwise. Give parameters and differences attaining each exact maximum, or prove the corresponding sharp maximum is smaller.

scope.domain: c-differential uniformity of a trace-perturbed inverse function
assumptions: c is nonzero and c is not 1
The c-differential convention is the one used in Theorem 9 of the source
scope.unresolved_remainder: For $n\ge 11$, the double-trace-one branch is now known to have exact uniformity eight. In the complementary branch only $8\le{}_c\Delta_H\le9$ is known, so attainment or exclusion of nine remains unresolved.

citations.label: Kaytanci--Ozbudak, exact and near-exact c-differential uniformity

progress.summary: The source proves upper bounds eight and nine in two trace branches and asks whether they are attained.
A later paper proves exact uniformity eight in the double-trace-one branch for n at least 11, while leaving the other branch between eight and nine.
